podcast.body: This 32-second song by The Pocket Gods is presented as an example of how artists are creating extremely short tracks, adapting to streaming economics where only plays over 30 seconds are monetized. "The Pocket Gods with you can't burn streams over and done in 32 seconds."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
